title: Initialisation refuses to replace an existing curated config
expectation: Both plain init and provider init fail without --force, preserving the config byte for byte and creating no provider workflow files.

checks.command: monochange init > .init.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cat .init.out; test $rc -eq 1 && cmp .config-original monochange.toml && grep -qi 'force' .init.out
checks.why: Default init must make replacement explicit and preserve all existing configuration.

checks.command: monochange init --provider github > .provider.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cat .provider.out; test $rc -eq 1 && cmp .config-original monochange.toml && grep -qi 'force' .provider.out && test ! -e .github
checks.why: Provider setup must not leave workflow side effects when the config cannot be replaced.
